description: SvListBox in Svelte 5 as an assignee picker: an inline multi-select list with options grouped by department, a roving keyboard with type-ahead, a fixed number of visible rows and a live summary of the selection. Controlled through value and onChange with multiple on.

faq.question: How are groups defined?
faq.answer: Options carry a group name; the list renders a heading per group and keeps keyboard navigation flowing across groups as one list.

faq.question: How does type-ahead work?
faq.answer: Typing letters while the list has focus jumps to the next option starting with them, following the WAI-ARIA listbox pattern; arrow keys move and Space toggles in multiple mode.

faq.question: How many rows are shown?
faq.answer: rows sets the visible height in options and the rest scroll; add virtual for very long lists.
